changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bookings ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, customer_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, tour_id BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (tour_id > 0), seats INT NOT NULL CHECK (seats > 0), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE booking_outbox ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL UNIQUE, event_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, booking_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id), customer_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, tour_id BIGINT NOT NULL, seats INT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, occurred_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, published BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL );
